primitives.name: Abstract Atmosphere Only
primitives.verbatim_quote: Rules (the doctrine — "generate atmosphere, render truth"): - Abstract atmosphere only.
primitives.assumptions: All visual elements must be non-informative, abstract, and devoid of data.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when any non-abstract element is introduced into plate generation.

layer2.mapping: GSE's plate kernel enforces abstraction constraint; GSI's inference engine validates against semantic contamination.
layer2.telemetry: Semantic content detection in plate assets.

primitives.name: Non-Odds Visual Compliance
primitives.verbatim_quote: No text, odds, logos, player likenesses, sportsbook imagery, or hype symbols baked in.
primitives.assumptions: Visual assets must not contain any commercial or predictive indicators.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Any embedded odds or logos invalidate plate compliance.

layer2.mapping: GSE's visual pipeline filters out all non-compliant elements; GSI's truth engine ensures final render is compliant.
layer2.telemetry: Compliance scan of plate metadata and pixel-level content.
